hero.title: Your money.
hero.description: A friendlier financial home for everyday people—from physical gold to money invested with family.
hero.promise: Built for confidence, not financial expertise.

principles.title: Understand at a glance
principles.detail: What you own. What you owe. What you can access. Clear totals, with missing information called out.

principles.title: One obvious next step
principles.detail: Add an asset or debt, or ask Falc. Relevant questions only—no finance vocabulary test.

principles.title: Trust before automation
principles.detail: Dated values. Estimates labelled. Samples kept separate. Review every assistant draft before saving.

navigation.title: Every destination has a clear job.
navigation.note: Reports and settings stay easy to reach. Team outreach stays separate from personal finances. On mobile, primary actions stay within reach.

steps.title: A short, guided path—not a spreadsheet.

falc.title: Meet Falc.
falc.description: Type naturally. Dictate if your browser supports it. Falc prepares the details; you stay in control.
falc.exampleAssistant: “I’ve started a draft. What is its current value—or should we leave it unknown?”
falc.disclaimer: Local guided mode works without an AI provider. Optional AI mode requires configuration and consent to share the conversation. Falc never trades, connects a wallet, or silently saves.

assets.kicker: 04 · Design the meaning, not just the numbers
assets.title: Different assets need different questions.

items.title: Physical gold
items.text: Weight + purity + purchase cost. Estimated resale value, not the original jewellery bill.

items.title: Family investments
items.text: Ownership, loan, or gift. Record the arrangement before interpreting the amount.

items.title: Money owed
items.text: Outstanding balance + repayment history. Never confuse borrowed money with wealth.

accessibility.title: Small details make it easier.
items: Readable text and generous tap targets.
Labels beside icons, not mystery buttons.
Search and filter before endless scrolling.
Clear errors next to the action that failed.
Keyboard focus, contrast, and reduced motion.
Confirmation for replacing or deleting records.

plain.liquidity: How quickly you can access it

rollout.title: Trust is a release requirement.

items.title: Build & check
items.text: Working guided entry, honest summaries, local history, and exports. Existing data preserved.

items.title: Configure & verify
items.text: Supabase accounts, reviewed migration, private access tests, backup and restore. Required before cloud launch.

items.title: Learn & expand
items.text: Invited user testing first. Then household permissions, documents, Arabic, and selected price feeds.

rollout.disclaimer: This infographic describes the experience and release plan—not a claim that every future feature is live. Cloud setup, external services, and public release require separate verification.

steps.title: Tell us what it is
steps.detail: Gold, cash, stocks, an IPO, a private investment, or a debt.

steps.title: Add what you know
steps.detail: Skip unknown values. Record currency, source, and date.

steps.title: Review the meaning
steps.detail: Ownership, a loan, or a gift? Available money or restricted?

steps.title: See one clear picture
steps.detail: Understand your recorded position without mistaking estimates for cash.
